categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, and sales of uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, power protection and management systems, power electronics equipment, computer peripherals and communication network devices, and software design and sales. The revenue breakdown for 2024 is approximately 56.44% from UPS systems, 30.38% from data center power management, 11.33% from power protection and management equipment, and 1.85% from power converters and computer peripherals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary research and development with seven independent R&D units focusing on different product lines, supported by in-house UL, cUL, CSA, ETL, and TUV certified safety laboratories and an anechoic chamber for electromagnetic testing. It develops smart power management software and SNMP/HTTP network modules, holding over 260 patents. Manufacturing is self-controlled to ensure quality, cost, and delivery, with production bases in Taiwan, Shenzhen, and the Philippines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad range of end users including households, enterprises, and data centers, with a strong presence in North America through major retailers like Best Buy, Office Depot, and Walmart, and distributors such as Ingram Micro and Tech Data. The data center and power management market is growing due to cloud services, AI, and 5G, while portable power converters target mobile device users globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with headquarters in Taipei, manufacturing facilities in Tainan (Taiwan), Shenzhen (China), and the Philippines, and subsidiaries in the USA, Europe, India, and other regions. Its main sales market is North America, with expanding presence in other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, designing and manufacturing power supply and management products. It sources key components like batteries, transformers, semiconductors, plastics, and PCBs from multiple suppliers but maintains long-term relationships and diversified sourcing to ensure supply stability. It sells finished products through retail, distribution, and system integrators to end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include investing 3-5% of annual revenue in R&D to develop innovative, energy-efficient, and smart power solutions aligned with market needs. The company focuses on integrated power management software, smart energy-saving systems, and power protection for audio-visual equipment. It aims to be a global leader in power management solutions by leveraging AI, cloud services, and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of UPS systems, power management devices, power converters, and related software. The company also provides customized solutions and after-sales services globally, leveraging direct sales, distributors, and system integrators.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading global brand in power management solutions, ranked second in North America for UPS brands and fourth globally in the 1-5 KVA UPS category. It competes by leveraging strong brand recognition, comprehensive R&D capabilities, self-controlled manufacturing, and extensive certifications. Competitors include other global UPS and power management solution providers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$12.49 billion, a 6.49% increase from the previous year, with a net profit of NT$2.31 billion and earnings per share of NT$24.75. The company shows strong profitability growth, with a 56.52% increase in net income year-over-year, and maintains a healthy financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio of 39.34%. R&D expenses represent about 3.79% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its strong brand CyberPower, comprehensive in-house R&D and manufacturing capabilities, and a broad product portfolio covering UPS, data center power management, and portable power solutions. It emphasizes product quality, reliability, energy efficiency, and smart management features, supported by extensive certifications and patents. Its ability to rapidly respond to market trends and customer feedback, combined with global sales and service networks, provides customers with trusted, innovative, and high-value power solutions.
